ohtani.title: Three-run homers from Taylor, Semien fuel Mets' win
ohtani.blurb: Tyrone Taylor and Marcus Semien hit three-run home runs in back-to-back innings, leading the Mets to an 8-3 win over the Dodgers

imanaga.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong's big day powers Cubs' win
imanaga.blurb: Pete Crow-Armstrong tallies three RBIs and Shota Imanaga tosses six scoreless innings in the Cubs' shutout win against the Pirates

suzuki.title: Bregman, Hoerner home runs spark Cubs' 7-3 win
suzuki.blurb: Alex Bregman and Nico Hoener go deep to propel the Cubs to a 7-3 win over the Cardinals

yoshida.title: Ceddanne Rafaela leads Red Sox to 4-2 victory
yoshida.blurb: Ceddanne Rafaela crushes his first career grand slam to power the Red Sox's 4-2 win over the A's

okamoto.title: Max Scherzer returns to the mound in Blue Jays' win
okamoto.blurb: Luis Urías and Ernie Clement help back Max Scherzer in his first start back on the mound from the IL in the Blue Jays' 3-2 win over the Nationals

murakami.title: Ali Sánchez drills first career homer in Yankees' win
murakami.blurb: Ali Sánchez crushes his first big league homer plus Jazz Chisholm Jr. drives in two to lead the Yankees to a 9-5 win over the White Sox

matsui.title: Machado and Merrill homer in Padres' comeback win
matsui.blurb: Padres rally late, led by game-tying and go-ahead homers by Manny Machado and Jackson Merrill, to beat the Marlins 5-3 and complete the sweep
